description: A dataset of dockless bike sharing trips and road network for Nanchang, China is a data set deposited in bl.leeds by its authors Yuanxuan Yang, Alison Heppenstall (University of Leeds). The dataset includes the data and scripts in the paper “ Yang Y, Heppenstall A, Turner AGD and Comber A. A spatiotemporal and graph-based analysis of dockless bike sharing patterns to understand urban flows over the last mile. Paper accepted for publication in Computers Environment and Urban Systems (July 2019)”. Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2019. Formats: TXT, ZIP. Size stated: 2 MB. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
